QuestInfo.name: Knight Maintenance
QuestInfo.0: Hawkeye says that he has some advice for you about being a Knight.
QuestInfo.1:
You get AP and SP if you train hard and level up. You can use these to enhance your abilities.

[AP Distribution]
You can open up the stats window with the hotkey S, and then you can assign AP to increase the stats needed for the class.
Use the Auto-Assign button to increase whatever is most useful for your character.

[SP Distribution]
Open up the skill window with the hotkey K, and then use available SP (Skill Points) to increase the level of your #1st attack skill#.
QuestInfo.2: You can become an even stronger knight if you use the AP and SP you received after becoming a Knight-in-Training. Train hard and bring honor to the Cygnus name.

1.0: Well? Did you try hunting after you used your new SP? Am I getting ahead of myself here?\r\n

yes.0: You should be ready for a good hunt now. Neinheart has some new mission for you. Go talk to him.

default.0: Hit the K key to open your skill window, and put a point into Lightning Punch.
